role: independent repository, canonical and evidence consistency critic
method: Read back live kimi, the frozen commit/tree, active control/addendum, status mirrors, canonical set, checkpoint evidence and matching Vercel Preview.

Compared the earlier path/claim proofs to later Route 01-3 additions and attempted rejection for unregistered IDs, stale zero-proof, historical evidence promotion, missing final paths, forbidden-path changes and deployment mismatch.

findings.finding: Floor 5 is defined as the first milestone boss, but the first-ten stable-ID set registers only the Floor 10 district boss. The Floor 5 persistent boss reference has no canonical ID.
findings.risk: Encounter data, screen state, analytics and migration would invent different identifiers in Step 2/5.
findings.requiredRepair: Register one canonical Floor 5 mid-boss ID and reference it explicitly in the slice document without changing the one-reset or tower semantics.

findings.finding: The existing path classification and zero-proof are valid only for earlier base commit `fd673...`; they predate addenda 011/012, policy and dependency closures, final critics and seal artifacts. They cannot prove the final tree has zero unclassified paths or current-authority contradictions.
findings.risk: A seal could rely on stale checkpoint evidence and omit newly introduced authority or review files.
findings.requiredRepair: Create a final repository postcheck bound to the repaired content/evidence ancestry, classify every post-base addition, re-evaluate the thirteen old-claim families and record forbidden-path/history integrity before final judge.

incidentReview.finding: No concealment or current-tree probe residue found.
